narrative.intro: AMI Metals received $2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. AMI Metals won 9 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $225M. Obligations fell and rose across prior years: FY21 $9.8K, FY22 $165K, FY23 $109K, FY24 $346K, FY25 $48.9K, FY26 $2B. Year over year obligations are up 4136383.9%. The Department of Homeland Security is the largest buyer of AMI Metals in FY2026 to date, obligating $2B. The Department of Defense obligated $13.5K. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services is the top NAICS market for AMI Metals in FY2026 to date with $2B in obligations. Other Support Activities for Air Transportation accounted for $13.5K. Current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date and the figures shown are contract obligations, except where tables list award values as total contract values.
